description: How long each operation takes, end to end, from the spans every surface emits: percentiles per span name and service from Tempo's span metrics in Prometheus, run duration beside cost, cold starts, store actions, snapshot and patch builds, client render and hydrate, the relay, and the server event loop and engine GC from the System Metrics sample lines. Phone spans ride the server's diagnostic-log pull and can be up to ~30 s behind.

panels.title: Engine spans p95
panels.description: p95 of every engine span per step, one line per span name: run.execute, llm.call, llm.attempt, tool.execute, extension.hook_latency, hook.fanout, dispatch.agent, command.dispatch, conversation.load, conversation.persist, context.assemble, compaction, mcp.start, mcp.call, extension.spawn, permission.decide, config.load, provider.probe, session.start, daemon.startup. Backend and Model filter the spans that carry those attributes. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="ion-engine"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~".+", service="ion-engine", backend=~"$backend", model=~"$model", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Server spans p95
panels.description: p95 of every Ion Studio Server span per step: action.handle, engine.request, engine.send_prompt, prompt.handle, snapshot.build, tabs_index.build, thin.first_paint, transcript.patch, body.serve, settled.publish, store.broadcast, git.exec, worktree.*, bench.rebuild, transfer.*, http.request, log.ingest, hello.auth, relay.frame, fleet.deploy, push.ring. Client kind filters the spans that carry it. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="ion-server"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~".+", service="ion-server", client_kind=~"$client_kind", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Client spans p95
panels.description: p95 of every client span per step, one line per service and span name. Desktop: app.launch, window.ready, studio.first_paint, store.hydrate, connection.connect, body.load, transcript.apply, prompt.send, prompt.visible, terminal.echo. iOS: app.launch, connection.connect, pairing.complete, snapshot.apply, transcript.apply, prompt.send, prompt.visible, push.open. A browser Studio tab is ion-web. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service=~"ion-desktop|ion-web|ion-ios"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~".+", service=~"ion-desktop|ion-web|ion-ios", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: p50 / p95 / p99 per span and service
panels.description: Every span name Tempo has seen in the range, by service, with its p50, p95, and p99 over the whole range. Sort by p99 to find the slowest operation. Seconds. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~".+", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~".+", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~".+", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: run.execute p50 / p95 by model
panels.description: How long an engine run takes from start to exit, per model, from the run.execute span. The alert "Ion run p95 over 120 s" reads the ungrouped p95. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="run.execute"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="run.execute", service="ion-engine", backend=~"$backend", model=~"$model", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="run.execute", service="ion-engine", backend=~"$backend", model=~"$model", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: LLM call, attempt, and tool p95
panels.description: Inside a run: llm.call is one model turn including retries, llm.attempt one request to the provider, tool.execute one tool call, provider.probe one provider reachability probe. A gap between llm.call and llm.attempt is retry time. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="ion-engine"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~"llm.call|llm.attempt|tool.execute|provider.probe", service="ion-engine", backend=~"$backend", model=~"$model", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Cost and duration per run, by model
panels.description: One row per model over the range: runs, average cost per run (run_cost_usd, this run only, excluding dispatched sub-agents), and the p95 run duration the engine reported on run.complete. Reads the telemetry event, so it needs telemetry enabled; the span panel beside it reads the same runs as spans. Source: {event_name="run.complete"}.

targets.expr: sum by (payload_model) (count_over_time({event_name="run.complete", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json [$__range]))

sum by (payload_model) (sum_over_time({event_name="run.complete", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | unwrap payload_run_cost_usd [$__range])) / sum by (payload_model) (count_over_time({event_name="run.complete", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, {event_name="run.complete", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | unwrap payload_duration_ms [$__range]) by (payload_model)

panels.title: Engine daemon startup p95
panels.description: daemon.startup: the engine process from start to the socket accepting clients, p95 over the range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="daemon.startup", service="ion-engine", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Studio app launch p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="app.launch", service="ion-desktop", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: iOS app launch p95
panels.description: app.launch on the phone: process start to the first screen, p95 over the range. Phone spans ride the server's diagnostic-log pull, so this can be up to ~30 s behind.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="app.launch", service="ion-ios", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Extension spawn p95
panels.description: extension.spawn: the engine starting an extension subprocess to its init handshake, p95 over the range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="extension.spawn", service="ion-engine", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Cold starts over time (p95)
panels.description: The start-up spans per step, one line per service and span: daemon.startup and session.start (engine), extension.spawn and mcp.start (engine), app.launch, window.ready and studio.first_paint (desktop), app.launch and pairing.complete (iOS). There is no Ion Studio Server start-up span; the server's first hello.auth marks its readiness.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~"daemon.startup|session.start|extension.spawn|mcp.start|app.launch|window.ready|studio.first_paint|pairing.complete", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: action.handle p95 by action
panels.description: The server's own time on one Studio store action, receipt to result sent, per action name (the `action` attribute). Client kind filters by the connection that sent it. The wire is not in this number; Ion Wire Latency has the client-felt figure. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="action.handle"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, action) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="action.handle", service="ion-server", client_kind=~"$client_kind", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Store actions per second by surface
panels.description: How many actions each Studio surface (the `surface` attribute) sends per second. Source: traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{span_name="action.handle"}.

targets.expr: sum by (surface) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{span_name="action.handle", service="ion-server", client_kind=~"$client_kind", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: engine.request p95 by command
panels.description: A server request to the engine, per client command (the `command` attribute), from send to the engine's answer. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="engine.request"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, command) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="engine.request", service="ion-server", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Prompt hand-off and engine command dispatch p95
panels.description: prompt.handle and engine.send_prompt (server): a prompt from receipt to the engine accepting it. command.dispatch (engine): one client command from receipt to its result, per command. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~"prompt.handle|engine.send_prompt", service="ion-server", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, command) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="command.dispatch", service="ion-engine", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: snapshot.build and tabs_index.build (what a connecting client receives), thin.first_paint (the phone's first screen), transcript.patch (one transcript delta), settled.publish and store.broadcast (fan-out to every connection). panels.title: Body serve and conversation persistence p95
panels.description: body.serve (server): one conversation body served to a client. conversation.load, conversation.persist, context.assemble, compaction (engine): reading and writing the conversation tree and building the model context. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name="body.serve", service="ion-server", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~"conversation.load|conversation.persist|context.assemble|compaction", service="ion-engine", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Client render and hydrate spans p95
panels.description: store.hydrate (desktop: the mirror store filled from the first snapshot), snapshot.apply (iOS), transcript.apply (both: one transcript delta rendered), body.load (desktop: a conversation body fetched and shown), connection.connect (both; Transport filters the desktop's). Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service=~"ion-desktop|ion-web|ion-ios"}.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, span_name) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~"store.hydrate|snapshot.apply|transcript.apply|body.load|connection.connect", service=~"ion-desktop|ion-web|ion-ios", transport=~"$transport", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: prompt.send: the operator submits until the server answers. prompt.visible: the same submit until the first token of the answer is on screen, the number a person feels. Per client service. Source: traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{span_name=~"prompt.send|prompt.visible"}.

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(relay_ping_rtt_seconds_bucket{le=~".+", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Runtime: event loop and garbage collector
Server event-loop delay (per-sample p50 / p99)
panels.description: How late the Ion Studio Server's event loop ran its timers, per device: the p50 and p99 within each 30 s sample, averaged over 5 m. A p99 above 200 ms for 5 minutes fires "Ion server event loop p99 over 200 ms". Source: server.jsonl tag=system-metrics fields.server_event_loop_p50_ms / server_event_loop_p99_ms.

targets.expr: avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-server", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="system-metrics" | msg="system metrics sample" | fields_server_event_loop_p50_ms != "" | unwrap fields_server_event_loop_p50_ms [5m]))

avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-server", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="system-metrics" | msg="system metrics sample" | fields_server_event_loop_p99_ms != "" | unwrap fields_server_event_loop_p99_ms [5m]))

panels.title: Engine GC pause p99 and scheduler latency p99
panels.description: The Go runtime's stop-the-world pause and goroutine scheduling latency inside the engine, per device: the p99 within each 30 s sample, averaged over 5 m. Source: engine.jsonl tag=sysmetrics fields.gc_pause_p99_ms / sched_latency_p99_ms.

targets.expr: avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-engine", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="sysmetrics" | msg=~"system metrics sample|HIGH MEMORY" | fields_gc_pause_p99_ms != "" | unwrap fields_gc_pause_p99_ms [5m]))

avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-engine", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="sysmetrics" | msg=~"system metrics sample|HIGH MEMORY" | fields_sched_latency_p99_ms != "" | unwrap fields_sched_latency_p99_ms [5m]))

panels.title: Engine allocation rate
panels.description: Bytes the engine allocated per second since the previous sample, per device. A climbing rate with a flat heap is churn the collector is paying for. Source: engine.jsonl tag=sysmetrics fields.alloc_rate_bytes_per_s.

targets.expr: avg by (host_name) (avg_over_time({service_name="ion-engine", event_name="", host_name=~"$host", user=~"$user"} | json | tag="sysmetrics" | msg=~"system metrics sample|HIGH MEMORY" | fields_alloc_rate_bytes_per_s != "" | unwrap fields_alloc_rate_bytes_per_s [5m]))

list.name: host
list.label: Device
list.description: The device a line came from (label `host_name`, the OTLP host.name). Multi-select; All includes lines with no device.

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: The signed-in operator (Alloy label `user`). Multi-select; All includes lines with no identity.

list.name: backend
list.label: Backend
list.description: The run's backend (`backend` span attribute): the engine's own model loop, or a delegated CLI. Filters engine spans; All keeps spans without the attribute.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: The model a run or call used (`model` span attribute). Filters engine spans; All keeps spans without the attribute.

list.name: transport
list.label: Transport
list.description: How Studio reached the server (`transport` on connection.connect). Filters client spans; All keeps spans without the attribute.

list.name: client_kind
list.label: Client kind
list.description: The connection kind the server saw (`client_kind` on server spans): desktop, web, or ios. Filters server spans; All keeps spans without the attribute.
